nodes.label: Deepslate Top Texture
nodes.description: 16x16 pixel block texture for the top face of deepslate. Dark grey with a concentric/radial ring pattern emanating from the center, giving a layered geological cross-section look. Distinguishes the top/bottom faces from side faces in game rendering.
nodes.pattern: concentric radial rings pattern, geological cross-section
nodes.game_purpose: top/bottom face variant of deepslate block, used in rendering top-face of underground stone
